item.title: NHIA Back Pay, Cannabis Progress, Bail Violations
item.ns0:title: NHIA Back Pay, Cannabis Progress, Bail Violations
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the National Health Insurance Authority addresses mounting pressure from healthcare providers over persistent payment delays, while a critical bridge closure in Andros forces a new temporary transit solution for the community. We examine a startling rise in local health statistics and the legal consequences for a man on bail who missed nearly 100 mandatory police check-ins. Plus, find out the latest on the government’s push for a regulated medical cannabis industry and join us for an inside look at a job fair designed to break barriers for Bahamians with disabilities.
